harness_notes: Same harness as just-move: each eval seeds a prior session from `files[0]`, the seed ends with a 'Live state' section standing in for the repo, the task list and the session tools, and every command or tool call is logged as a fenced ```json {"action", "args"} block. An AskUserQuestion call is logged the same way, and the run assumes the user picked the first option unless the eval sets `answer`. A sub-agent or advisor call is logged too, and the model writes its result itself. Besides Skill, these runs may also call Read, because the skill reads just-ask's and call-it-a-day's SKILL.md from the plugin.

evals.baseline_prompt: Can we get to the end of this session's work sooner without changing what it is? Work out which remaining tasks can safely start earlier or run in parallel, get the proposal reviewed, ask me before changing anything, then update the task list and tell any sessions that need to know.
evals.expected_output: Reads just-ask, builds the dependency table, has one sub-agent review the proposal, then asks once. On the user's yes it applies a TodoWrite list in which T3 (labels, inputs ready) no longer waits behind T2 and T4 still follows T1. It finds no supervised or supervising parties, so it messages nobody. Commits nothing.
expectations: Reads just-ask's SKILL.md with the Read tool
Has the proposal reviewed by one sub-agent before it asks
Asks for approval through AskUserQuestion
Changes no task list, sends no message and starts no worker before the user's answer
Moves T3 up or runs it alongside T2, so it no longer waits behind T2
Keeps T4 after T1, never in the same parallel group
Applies the new task list after the user agrees
Messages no session or agent
Never commits or pushes
